boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-purchase group activities and open climbing for Quinnipiac community members.

cards.title: Join a yoga class
cards.subtitle: Group fitness · Quinnipiac campuses
cards.notes: Reserve a yoga session through RecWell, then arrive ready to move with classmates. Choose a class time that fits your schedule and comfort level.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost, instructor-led way to move and reset with other students.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac states that free fitness classes run throughout the semester and identifies yoga among the offerings.
cards.access_notes: For Quinnipiac students; class sign-ups open 24 hours before the start time through RecWell.

cards.title: Take a Pilates class
cards.subtitle: Group fitness · Quinnipiac campuses
cards.notes: Use RecWell to find a Pilates session, sign up when registration opens, and bring a friend for a structured, low-key movement break.

cards.entity_name: Open Climb at the Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.title: Climb at Open Climb
cards.subtitle: Recreation and Wellness Center · Mount Carmel Campus
cards.notes: Bring your Quinnipiac ID to Open Climb and use the provided climbing equipment. Check the current schedule before walking over with your group.
cards.short_summary: Climb the campus wall with equipment supplied at no charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac’s catalog says all climbing-wall equipment is provided free of charge and publishes weekly Open Climb sessions.
cards.source_title: Campus Recreation | Quinnipiac University Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: For Quinnipiac students and staff; Open Climb is listed Monday–Thursday 4–8 p.m., Friday 4–7 p.m., Saturday 3–6 p.m.; schedule may change.
